title: Overlapping Reserves without a Common Priority: Theory and an Application to School Choice in Chile
abstract: arXiv:2610.28471v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study matching markets with overlapping reserves governed by heterogeneous priorities. When applicants qualify for multiple reserves, how they are routed can affect reserve utilization and which applicants are admitted. We introduce classify-and-rank choice rules that yield strategy-proof deferred acceptance mechanisms satisfying maximum reserve utilization and priority-respect. We axiomatically characterize our mechanism's admission outcomes for any given classification and reserve order. With two reserve categories, we provide a foundation for the reserve order and establish its distributional implications for access across eligibility groups. Using nine cycles of Chilean school admissions, which feature such reserves, we document reserve-utilization failures under the deployed mechanism and show that their frequency depends sharply on the reserve order. translated_title: 无共同优先级的重叠保留名额：理论及其在智利学校选择中的应用
translated_abstract: 我们研究由异质性优先权管辖、含有重叠保留名额的匹配市场。当申请者符合多个保留名额的条件时，他们的分流方式会影响保留名额的利用率以及哪些申请者被录取。我们引入了“分类—排序”（classify-and-rank）选择规则，由此得到的延迟接受机制满足策略无欺性（防操纵）、最大保留名额利用率以及优先权尊重。我们公理化地刻画了在任意给定的分类和保留名额顺序下该机制的录取结果。针对两个保留名额类别的情况，我们为保留名额顺序提供了理论基础，并确立了其对不同资格群体入学机会的分配影响。利用具有此类保留名额的智利九个招生周期的数据，我们记录了现行机制下保留名额利用失败的现象，并表明其发生频率在很大程度上取决于保留名额的顺序。我们展示了如何将我们的机制适配到智利的制度环境中以促进入学机会。
tldr: 本文提出“分类—排序”选择规则，为重叠保留名额匹配市场构建了满足策略无欺、最大保留名额利用和优先权尊重的延迟接受机制，并利用智利学校招生数据揭示现行机制的保留名额利用失败问题及其对保留名额顺序的敏感性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces classify-and-rank choice rules that yield strategy-proof deferred acceptance mechanisms with maximum reserve utilization and priority-respect for matching markets with overlapping reserves, and applies them to Chilean school admissions to document reserve-utilization failures whose frequency depends sharply on the reserve order.
